title: Korean-Style Skewered Pork with Cucumber Slices
description: A refreshing and flavorful dish that combines the sweetness of pork with the crunch of cucumber, all wrapped up in a spicy Korean-inspired marinade.

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Try to get a mix of lean and fatty meat for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Ginger, grated
ingredients.notes: Use a microplane to get the right texture

ingredients.name: Garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Mince it finely so it distributes evenly

ingredients.name: Soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Use a good-quality, low-sodium soy sauce

ingredients.name: Brown sugar
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality, pure cane sugar

ingredients.name: Cucumber slices
ingredients.notes: Choose thin slices for the best texture

ingredients.name: Green onions, thinly sliced
ingredients.notes: Use the green parts only for the best flavor

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar, minari, ginger, and garlic.
Add the pork cubes to the marinade and toss to coat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat. Thread the marinated pork cubes and cucumber slices onto skewers.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning frequently, until the pork is cooked through and the cucumber is slightly charred.
Transfer the skewers to a serving platter and garnish with thinly sliced green onions.
